subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be handled as expected shared-DM configuration/support, as a Telegram/session-routing or delivery bug, or as a new semantic runaway-output safety guard?
rationale: Current source proves adjacent routing, isolation, abort, and delivery safeguards, but the payload-free report does not identify which boundary actually failed and each option has different product and compatibility consequences.

options.title: Keep as manual incident tracker
options.body: Preserve this issue until maintainers can review redacted screenshots/logs or live Telegram proof and choose the correct boundary before code work.

options.title: Route to config/support
options.body: Treat the two-chat behavior as expected when dmScope remains main and answer with secure DM-mode guidance instead of changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Sponsor a safety guard
options.body: Approve a new runaway-output or cross-chat semantic guard and define the desired channel/session policy before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep as manual incident tracker
recommendation.body: Preserve this issue until maintainers can review redacted screenshots/logs or live Telegram proof and choose the correct boundary before code work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans session routing defaults, delivery safety, and product guidance, and this handle has the broadest recent history across those boundaries.
